Active research-project theses

Scope: thematic-researcher (slice: own + notes you contributed to) Active: 3 · Recently closed (last 14d): 0

These are analyst-owned long-running research threads. Each thesis is a living document — the analyst's evolving synthesis of accumulated research discussion, fact-check, mailbox, and operator-action material. Use this to - avoid re-deriving conclusions another analyst is actively building - weight your own claims against an established thesis (especially when it disagrees) - cite the project thesis directly when its conclusion is load-bearing, rather than re-running a web search

Verify fundable and accepted AI data center capacity

Owner: ai-infrastructure-analyst · Thesis v3 · Ticks: 2 · Materials: 81 · Deadline: 13d left · project_id: rp_09c8dbb412994609

Kickoff: Track which AI data center orders, announced MW, and China AIDC/neocloud projects are actually financed, energized, liquid-cooling accepted, and billing under take-or-pay or equivalent contracted demand. This matters because the analyst repeatedly treats site-level evidence as superior to sector narrative and sees unverified MW as the main source of valuation error.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when the covered project universe is classified by named site into at least three evidence tiers: energized and billing, funded with firm power/cooling acceptance pending, or announced capacity without verifiable power/cooling/customer acceptance.

Verify fundable and accepted AI data center capacity

Kickoff: Track which AI data center orders, announced MW, and China AIDC/neocloud projects are actually financed, energized, liquid-cooling accepted, and billing under take-or-pay or equivalent contracted demand. This matters because the analyst repeatedly treats site-level evidence as superior to sector narrative and sees unverified MW as the main source of valuation error.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when the covered project universe is classified by named site into at least three evidence tiers: energized and billing, funded with firm power/cooling acceptance pending, or announced capacity without verifiable power/cooling/customer acceptance.

1. 当前判断

本轮结论仍偏审慎：AI数据中心MW不能按公告容量估值，必须先按“已送电且计费 / 已融资但电力或液冷验收待完成 / 仅公告无可验证接受”三层折价；active MW的核心稀缺来自已并网、已许可、可冷却和有备用方案，而非抽象capex evidence ref evidence ref。Riot Rockdale/Anthropic提供了具名站点租约证据，但仍停在“融资和棕地改造执行待验收”而非“已全量AI billing”的层级；这确认th_p_7cd52609和th_p_1a4a76b5的time-to-power筛选，但不足以推导加密矿商板块整体重估 evidence ref evidence ref

Trigger watch: 集运/海运顺价：运费脉冲 + 绕行运力损耗（复航后进入验证期）

Owner: daily-report-editor · Thesis v7 · Ticks: 4 · Materials: 39 · Deadline: 9d left · project_id: rp_73b6a19cafb84ab6

Kickoff: Auto-derived invalidation watch for th_T16 ("集运/海运顺价：运费脉冲 + 绕行运力损耗（复航后进入验证期）"). Stated triggers: 证伪触发（原文条款）：SCFI 周环比跌 >10% 且新加坡低拥挤窗口 >2.0 天 → STRONG_BUY 降 REDUCE/SELL。. Check whether any trigger condition has fired; report with numbers either way.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when the thesis status flips (invalidated/revised/expired) or contradicting/revising evidence is recorded after this goal's creation.

Trigger watch: 集运/海运顺价：运费脉冲 + 绕行运力损耗（复航后进入验证期）

Kickoff: Auto-derived invalidation watch for th_T16 ("集运/海运顺价：运费脉冲 + 绕行运力损耗（复航后进入验证期）"). Stated triggers: 证伪触发（原文条款）：SCFI 周环比跌 >10% 且新加坡低拥挤窗口 >2.0 天 → STRONG_BUY 降 REDUCE/SELL。. Check whether any trigger condition has fired; report with numbers either way.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when the thesis status flips (invalidated/revised/expired) or contradicting/revising evidence is recorded after this goal's creation.

1. 当前判断

th_T16 的双条件证伪未触发：2026-08-07 SCFI 3276.14、周环比约 +2.19%，不是周跌 >10%；新加坡 2026-08-02 至 08-08 中位等待 0.12 天，亦未超过 >2.0 天阈值[web:turn0search0][web:turn1search16]。因此 STRONG_BUY 机械降级条件未满足，但复航后验证期仍需保留，因为 KB 已记录霍尔木兹与苏伊士 2026Q2 同步恢复、Drewry WCI 自高点回落 40%-46%evidence ref。新加坡低拥挤削弱“拥堵放大绕行损耗”的边际证据，但与“2026 年中运费再度飙升而非正常化”的房内事实并存，当前结论是维持观察而非确认失效evidence ref[mailbox_message:[source-id-redacted]]。

2. 关键证据

  • SCFI 2026-08-07 为 3276.14，周增 70.17 点[web:turn0search0]
  • SCFI 周环比约 +2.19%，未触发周跌 >10%[web:turn0search0]
  • 新加坡 2026-08-02 至 08-08 中位等待 0.12 天[web:turn1search16]
  • 0.12 天低于 >2.0 天阈值，拥堵腿未触发[web:turn1search16]

1. 当前判断

th_T11 尚未触发失效：第一触发器“云收入回落但capex不减→全组重定价”未完全成立，GOOGL Cloud +63%、利润率32.9%仍被奖励，而META capex 25-145B被惩罚，价格信号仍是ROI分化而非全组杀估值 [source:th_T11] evidence ref。第二触发器“任一家下调capex节奏”亦未见 fired，既有材料仍指向四大云厂商2026-2027 capex上调且未见放缓 evidence ref。但AMZN TTM FCF仅.2B、云商租赁义务>$850B，叠加电网/变压器接入约束与电子两融拥挤，说明FCF拐点和硬件链兑现仍需修订监控 [source:th_T11] evidence ref evidence ref。
